text.autoconfig.simplevisuals.title: Simple Visuals
text.autoconfig.simplevisuals.option.par:
Particle amount for every effect left on Global
level in the effect tabs (Movement, Nature,
Water and the others). Vanilla's particle
setting Minimal turns them off. Looks only, no
effect on gameplay. Default: Subtle.
text.autoconfig.simplevisuals.option.vis: Player Locator

Player heads for Vanilla waypoints in the
locator bar; server visibility and bar priority
remain. Default: On.
Chat Heads

Shows the sender's head beside player chat
messages, in the right margin of the chat.
Default: On.
Status Effect Bars

Shows a bar with the remaining duration under
status effect icons (HUD and inventory). Effects
without an end have no bar. Default: On.
Elytra Pitch Helper

While gliding, a line appears as soon as your
pitch is close to one of the two target angles.
Does not change the flight. Default: On.
Target Angle Up

Upward target pitch in degrees (negative = nose
up), -90 to 90. Default: -40.0.
Target Angle Down

Downward target pitch in degrees, -90 to 90.
Default: 40.0.
Pitch Tolerance

Up to how many degrees away from a target angle
the line is still shown, 0 to 45. Default: 10.0.
Guide Sensitivity

How far the line moves per degree of difference,
0 to 10. Default: 4.0.
Renamed item model compatibility

Compatibility; automatically disabled with
Simple Models. Enables custom textures for
renamed items based on the files in the config
folder. §cRequires a game restart to take
effect! Default: Off.
Enable Anvil Formatting codes

The server policy decides; Vanilla costs remain.
Allows '&' as a formatting code in anvil names
(for example &c for red). The obfuscated style
&k has its own lock (allowAnvilObfuscation).
Default: On.
Allow obfuscated text (&k)

Server policy (permission 2): allows the
unreadable obfuscated style &k in anvil names.
Off keeps &k locked and drops it from the name;
other codes stay. Default: Off.
Enhance own death messages

Adds your position to your own death message in
your chat. Only you see it; the form is set
under Own death coordinates. Default: On.
Own death coordinates

Off, appended to the message, or a separate
line. Only your own death, entirely local; other
players' positions are never shown. Default:
Separate local line.
Map Tooltips

Hovering over a filled map shows a 128-pixel
preview, its center coordinates and the
dimension. Default: On.
Flat blocks and panes in item frames from above

Pressure plates, carpets, trapdoors, glass panes
and bars lie flat in item frames as a 3D model
seen from above, instead of a thin strip or a
flat icon. Sneak with a chisel on the frame to
tilt it in 15° steps up to 90° and back (saved
per frame). Default: On.
Stand under a cauldron on a campfire

A cauldron standing on a campfire (also a soul
campfire, lit or not) is drawn on a small stand
in the cauldron's own color: four corner posts
and a frame. Looks only, no block and no
collision; takes effect when the chunks are
rebuilt (F3+A). Default: On.
Enable damage numbers

Numbers above nearby visible creatures when they
lose health (at most 32 at a time). Looks only,
no effect on gameplay. Default: On.
Scale

Size of the damage numbers, 0.5 to 2. Default:
1.0.
Color normal

Color of normal damage numbers as a decimal RGB
number (16711680 = red). Default: 16777215
(white).
Color high hit (above 8)

Color for high hits (damage above 8) as a
decimal RGB number; not a critical-hit marker.
Default: 16766720 (gold).
Text shadow

Draws the damage numbers with a dark shadow so
they stay readable on bright ground. Default:
On.
Enable

Shows the biome name at the top of the screen
when you enter another biome. Default: Off.
Display duration (ticks)

How long the biome name stays, in ticks (20 = 1
second), 20 to 600. Default: 60.
Cooldown seconds

After you leave a biome, its name is not shown
again for this many seconds, 0 to 3600. Default:
60.
Y offset

Distance of the biome name from the top of the
screen in pixels. Default: 50.
Enable Speed Lines
Speed Lines Color (RGB)

Color of the speed lines as a decimal RGB number
(16711680 = red). Default: 16777215 (white).
Speed Lines Opacity

Opacity of the speed lines, 0 (invisible) to 1
(strongest). Default: 0.7.
Speed Lines Amount

Multiplier for the number of lines, 0 (none) to
2 (double); never more than 90 lines. Default:
1.0.
Speed Lines Tunnel Radius

Size of the free middle as a share of the screen
height, 0.2 to 1. Default: 0.7.
Speed Lines Width

Thickness of each line in pixels, at most 8.
Default: 8.0.
Speed Lines Animation Speed

How fast the lines move, 0 (still) to 4.
Default: 1.0.
Speed Lines Length

Length of the lines (1 = 30 pixels), 0 to 4.
Default: 4.0.
Speed Lines Speed Threshold

Speed in blocks per tick from which the lines
appear (full speed while gliding, otherwise
horizontal), 0.05 to 4. A sudden speed-up shows
them too. Default: 0.6.
Enable Held Item Tooltips

Durability and enchantments appear under the
item name that shows when you switch items.
Default: On.
Show Durability

Shows the durability (left / maximum) of items
that wear out. Default: On.
Show Enchantments

Lists the enchantments of the held item.
Default: On.
Max Enchantments to Show

Enchantment lines shown at most, 0 to 8; the
rest is counted as '… and N more'. Default: 3.
Enable Pickup Notifier

A short row for every item or experience you
pick up (up to eight rows at a time). Default:
On.
Offset X

Distance of the rows from the chosen screen side
in pixels. Default: 10.
Offset Y

Distance of the rows from the bottom of the
screen in pixels. Default: 10.
Scale
Size of the rows, 0.5 to 2. Default: 1.0.
Display Duration (ticks)

How long a row stays, in ticks (20 = 1 second),
20 to 600. Default: 120.
Show XP
Also shows picked-up experience. Default: On.
Screen Side
Screen side of the rows. Default: Right.
Content Layout

Order of count, icon and name in a row. Default:
Count, icon, name.
Show item icon
Shows the item icon in the row. Default: On.
Show item name
Shows the item name in the row. Default: On.
Show item count

Shows the picked-up count in the row. Default:
On.
Use rarity color

Colors the item name by its rarity (experience
in green). Default: On.
Vanilla background style

Lighter background, half as dark; off gives a
darker one. Default: On.
Background Opacity

Opacity of the row background, 0 (none) to 1.
Default: 1.0.

simplevisuals.guide.page.1.title: Simple Visuals
simplevisuals.guide.page.1: Bounded client HUD, tooltips, anvil formatting and Vanilla immersion particles. Open this guide again with /simplevisuals guide.
simplevisuals.guide.page.2.title: Speed lines
simplevisuals.guide.page.2: Bounded radial lines at high speed or acceleration; cosmetic only, first-person view.
simplevisuals.guide.page.3.title: Pickup notifications
simplevisuals.guide.page.3: Server pickup animations create up to eight short-lived item or XP rows, with four layouts, scale, side, opacity and rarity colors. No inventory mutation.
simplevisuals.guide.page.4.title: Elytra pitch helper
simplevisuals.guide.page.4: Two target lines while gliding; defaults -40 and 40 degrees, tolerance 10, sensitivity 4. Does not change flight.
simplevisuals.guide.page.5.title: Status effect duration bars
simplevisuals.guide.page.5: HUD and inventory bars compare the current duration with the greatest observed duration of that active effect. Infinite effects have no bar; reconnecting clears history.
simplevisuals.guide.page.6.title: Locator player heads
simplevisuals.guide.page.6: Uses only server-supplied Vanilla waypoints; replaces eligible icons with player heads and keeps Vanilla angles, visibility and elevation arrows.
simplevisuals.guide.page.7.title: Locator player heads
simplevisuals.guide.page.7: SimpleBuilding contextual bars keep their priority.
simplevisuals.guide.page.8.title: Chat player heads
simplevisuals.guide.page.8: Faces beside recognizable player messages use cached Vanilla skins. No skin download service or custom chat packets.
simplevisuals.guide.page.9.title: Local death coordinates
simplevisuals.guide.page.9: Disabled, appended, or separate local coordinate line for your own death message.
simplevisuals.guide.page.10.title: Local death coordinates
simplevisuals.guide.page.10: Appended is still local, never public; other players' positions are not revealed.
simplevisuals.guide.page.11.title: Map preview tooltips
simplevisuals.guide.page.11: A 128-pixel map preview, center coordinates and dimension id from map data already available to this client.
simplevisuals.guide.page.12.title: Held item information
simplevisuals.guide.page.12: Durability and up to eight enchantment lines accompany the Vanilla held-item name. Enchantment changes refresh the notification.
simplevisuals.guide.page.13.title: Damage indicators
simplevisuals.guide.page.13: Up to 32 short-lived numbers for observed health decreases of nearby visible living entities, on by default. Switch them off in the Damage tab or with /simplevisuals visuals damageIndicators enable false.
simplevisuals.guide.page.14.title: Damage indicators
simplevisuals.guide.page.14: Values above eight use the high-hit color; this does not prove a critical or Smite hit. Solid blocks hide numbers.
simplevisuals.guide.page.15.title: Biome notifications
simplevisuals.guide.page.15: Optional biome name on transition, with display duration, offset and re-entry cooldown. Disabled by default.
simplevisuals.guide.page.16.title: Anvil formatting and uses
simplevisuals.guide.page.16: Valid & or section-sign color/style codes are accepted only under server formatting policy. The unreadable obfuscated style &k stays locked unless the server allows it.
simplevisuals.guide.page.17.title: Anvil formatting and uses
simplevisuals.guide.page.17: Vanilla anvil costs and 50-character name limit remain. Shows prior work uses from repair cost when no result is present.
simplevisuals.guide.page.18.title: Renamed model compatibility
simplevisuals.guide.page.18: Opt-in CIT JSON under assets/<namespace>/cit and PNG files in config/simplevisuals/textures.
simplevisuals.guide.page.19.title: Renamed model compatibility
simplevisuals.guide.page.19: Exact custom-name match, item filter, tags, deterministic weight priority, bounded search pages and anvil rename instructions.
simplevisuals.guide.page.20.title: Renamed model compatibility
simplevisuals.guide.page.20: Generated Vanilla item definitions bridge legacy model paths. At most 128 rules;
simplevisuals.guide.page.21.title: Renamed model compatibility
simplevisuals.guide.page.21: PNGs at most 1 MiB and 256 pixels per axis. Simple Models, when installed, owns this feature and disables this compatibility handler.
simplevisuals.guide.page.22.title: Configuration commands
simplevisuals.guide.page.22: Server: /simplevisuals config visuals enableAnvilFormatting [true|false] and allowAnvilObfuscation [true|false], permission level 2. Cosmetic options use the local client screen;
simplevisuals.guide.page.23.title: Configuration commands
simplevisuals.guide.page.23: server settings never overwrite another player's HUD.
